lines.en: label sanadorm15:
: Hey, Sana. Are you in there?
lines.zh: : 嘿，Sana。你在里面吗？

lines.en: : Is...Is that you, Sensei?...
lines.zh: : 是……是 Sensei 吗？……

lines.en: : Do you...need something?...
lines.zh: : 你……有什么事吗？……

lines.en: Sana decides to call out from behind the door instead of timidly walking up and whispering through it this time.
lines.zh: Sana 这次决定隔着门喊话，而不是像之前那样怯生生地凑到门边、贴着门缝小声嘀咕。

lines.en: My mission to teach her public speaking is now complete and I have officially done all I can possibly do for this girl.
lines.zh: 我教她当众讲话的任务就此完成，能为这姑娘做的，我也已经全部做完了。

lines.en: : I was wondering if you wanted to hang out.
lines.zh: : 我在想你要不要一起玩。

lines.en: : Um...I can't...
: Why not?
lines.zh: : 为什么不行？

lines.en: : Um...because...I’m...
: Because I'm...in my pajamas...
lines.zh: : 因为我……穿着睡衣……

lines.en: : That's it? That's your reason?
lines.zh: : 就这样？这就是你的理由？

lines.en: : What, are you embarrassed to be seen that way or something? Because I really don't care.
lines.zh: : 怎么，你是不好意思被别人看到这副样子还是怎么的？反正我是真不在乎。

lines.en: : I...uhh...maybe...a little bit?...
lines.zh: : 我……呜……也许……有一点吧？……

lines.en: : But I...feel bad since you came all this way, so...I guess you can still come in...
lines.zh: : 可是你都特意跑这一趟了，我……挺过意不去的，所以……我想你还是可以进来的……

lines.en: scene black
I figure that the only reason Sana would be embarrassed to be seen in her pajamas is that they might reveal a bit more skin than normal-
lines.zh: 我心想，Sana 会不好意思被人看到穿睡衣的样子，唯一的理由大概就是那身睡衣会比平时多露一点肌肤——

lines.en: scene games1
But my theory falls flatter than, well...Sana. Because she's even more covered up than normal.
lines.zh: 可我的推测落空得比——嗯……比 Sana 还平。因为她裹得比平时还要严实。

lines.en: And also too cute to be an actual human being.
lines.zh: 而且可爱到不像是真的人类。

lines.en: Since when am I attracted to girls wearing sweaters that weigh probably more than they do?
lines.zh: 从什么时候开始，我竟然会对穿着一件大概比她本人还重的毛衣的女孩心动了？

lines.en: scene games2
: Umm...Sensei?...Are you okay?...
lines.zh: : 嗯……Sensei？……你还好吗？……

lines.en: : Why are you just...looking at me like that?...
lines.zh: : 你为什么只是……那样看着我？……

lines.en: : Sorry. I zoned out for a second as I came to terms with a new aspect of myself.
lines.zh: : 抱歉。我刚刚走神了一下，正在接受自己新的一面。

lines.en: scene games3
: I..umm...okay?...
: I don't really know what that means, but...I'm happy if that...makes you happy...
lines.zh: : 我不太明白那是什么意思，不过……如果那……能让你开心，那我也开心……

lines.en: : Just out of curiosity, aren't you a little warm? It’s summer and you’re in a hoodie meant for someone my size.
lines.zh: : 我只是好奇，你不热吗？现在是夏天，你还穿着一件按我的尺码做的连帽衫。

lines.en: : I...like to keep the air on really high, so...I don’t mind...
lines.zh: : 我……喜欢把空调开得很足，所以……我不介意……

lines.en: : I kind of like...being bundled up like this...
lines.zh: : 我其实还挺喜欢……这样把自己裹起来的……

lines.en: Now that she mentions it, it {i}is{/i} borderline freezing in here. I’m actually kind of regretting not wearing a hoodie myself, but I honestly don't even think I own one.
lines.zh: 她这么一说，屋里{i}确实{/i}冷得快要结冰了。我甚至有点后悔自己没穿件连帽衫来，不过说实话，我大概根本就没有那种衣服。

lines.en: : So, what were you up to before I showed up and ruined your night? Studying?
lines.zh: : 那么，在我出现、毁掉你的夜晚之前，你在干什么？学习？

lines.en: scene games1
: I don't...really like studying...
lines.zh: : 我……不太喜欢学习……

lines.en: : I was just...playing games and stuff...
lines.zh: : 我刚刚只是在……打游戏之类的……

lines.en: : First, can you confirm that I'm not actually ruining your night? Because I kind of expected you to deny that and you just completely ignored it.
lines.zh: : 首先，你能先确认一下我其实并没有毁掉你的夜晚吗？因为我本以为你会否认，结果你直接把那句给忽略过去了。

lines.en: : You...didn't ruin my night, Sensei...
lines.zh: : 你……没有毁掉我的夜晚，Sensei……

lines.en: : Thank you. So, what game are you playing?
lines.zh: : 谢谢。那么，你在玩什么游戏？

lines.en: : Um...it's...a game called Animal Crossing...
lines.zh: : 嗯……是……一款叫《动物森友会》的游戏……

lines.en: : You kind of just...build a village and run around it doing...village stuff...
lines.zh: : 大概就是……建一个村子，然后在里面跑来跑去，做些……村里的事……

lines.en: : But it’s...really fun and you can...easily lose track of time while playing it...
lines.zh: : 但它……真的很好玩，玩着玩着就……很容易忘记时间……

lines.en: : Can't say I’ve ever heard of it.
lines.zh: : 我倒是从来没听说过。

lines.en: : You...can watch if you want?
lines.zh: : 你……想看的话可以看的？……

lines.en: : Which...actually doesn't sound very fun, so...I'm sorry for suggesting it...
lines.zh: : 不过……其实听起来没什么意思，所以……抱歉我还提出来……

lines.en: : It sounds better than doing nothing, so sure. I'm in.
lines.zh: : 总比干坐着强，行啊，我看。

lines.en: scene games3
: You’re...okay with just watching?...
lines.zh: : 你……光看着也行吗？……

lines.en: : Because I...have games we could play together instead...
lines.zh: : 因为我……也有可以一起玩的游戏……

lines.en: : I just...have to sell my turnips first...
lines.zh: : 我只是……得先把大头菜卖掉……

lines.en: : I really don’t mind, Sana. You looked happy when you were talking about the animal game or whatever, so I'd like to check that out if you're still okay with it.
lines.zh: : 我真的不介意，Sana。你聊起那个动物游戏什么的的时候看起来很开心，所以如果你还愿意的话，我想看看。

lines.en: scene games1
: Oh...yeah. Of course I'm...okay with it...
lines.zh: : 哦……嗯。我当然……愿意……

lines.en: : I'll even let you...choose what outfit I wear...
lines.zh: : 我甚至可以让你……来挑我穿哪套衣服……

lines.en: God, I wish that sentence meant what I wanted it to mean.
lines.zh: 天啊，我真希望那句话是我心里想的那个意思。

lines.en: Perversions aside, though, do people really have fun playing a game where you just...manage a village and...sell turnips?
lines.zh: 不过撇开那些下流的念头不谈，真的有人会觉得一款只是……经营村子、卖大头菜的游戏好玩吗？

lines.en: scene games5
Sana walks over to the bed and grabs a handheld console off of her end table. I follow suit and take a seat next to her.
lines.zh: Sana 走到床边，从床头柜上拿起一台掌机。我也跟着在她身边坐下。

lines.en: Surprisingly, she actually moves closer to me once I sit down.
lines.zh: 出乎意料的是，我一坐下，她反而往我这边凑近了些。

lines.en: I'm sure it's just to give me a better view of the game, but I like to think it's because she's starting to feel more comfortable around me for reasons beyond my comprehension.
lines.zh: 我确信她只是想让我看得更清楚，但我更愿意认为，是因为她待在我身边时开始感到自在了，至于原因，我无从理解。

lines.en: : Okay, so...
: I guess I...can just show you around the town first...
lines.zh: : 我想我……可以先带你逛逛村子……

lines.en: : You built all of that?
lines.zh: : 这些全都是你建的吗？

lines.en: : Well, there are some things already built when you first get here...but I did organize most of it, yeah...
lines.zh: : 嗯，刚来的时候有些东西本来就有……不过大部分是我规划的，对……

lines.en: : It took...way longer than I'd like to admit, though...
lines.zh: : 不过花的时间……比我愿意承认的要多得多……

lines.en: : I see. And what’s that building there?
lines.zh: : 这样啊。那边那栋建筑是什么？

lines.en: scene games6
: That’s the museum. It’s where you put bones and stuff.
lines.zh: : 那是博物馆。放骨头之类的地方。

lines.en: : This game is much more violent than it looks.
lines.zh: : 这游戏比看上去暴力多了。

lines.en: : Not...human bones, Sensei...Ones you find in the ground...
lines.zh: : 不是……人的骨头啦，Sensei……是从地里挖出来的那种……

lines.en: : I think you should relocate your village to somewhere with a brighter history.
lines.zh: : 我觉得你应该把村子搬到一个历史没那么阴暗的地方去。

lines.en: : Heheh...I guess I...should have just called them fossils...
lines.zh: : 嘿嘿……我想我……应该直接说化石就好了……

lines.en: : But, umm...you can also put stuff like...fish and bugs into the museum as well...
lines.zh: : 不过，嗯……你也可以把……鱼啊虫子啊之类的放进博物馆……

lines.en: : It's like a...big building for all of the stuff you can collect...
lines.zh: : 就像一栋……装着你收集到的所有东西的大房子……

lines.en: : And all of this is just laying around outside?
lines.zh: : 这些东西就那么随随便便散落在外面？

lines.en: scene games5
: Well...there's some searching involved, but...yeah. Kind of...
lines.zh: : 嗯……还是要找一找的，不过……嗯。差不多吧……

lines.en: : And who’s that guy over there? What does he do?
lines.zh: : 那边那个人是谁？他是干什么的？

lines.en: scene games6
: That’s one of the villagers. He just...walks around all day.
lines.zh: : 那是其中一个村民。他整天就……到处走走。

lines.en: : What a life.
lines.zh: : 活得真自在。

lines.en: I say, momentarily forgetting that that's essentially all I do as well.
lines.zh: 我说道，一时忘了这基本上也是我每天的全部日常。

lines.en: : Oh! I should show you my house too. I...I worked really hard on it, so...
lines.zh: : 哦！我也该带你看看我的房子。我……我在这上面花了好多心思，所以……

lines.en: : So...don't say anything mean about it, please...
lines.zh: : 所以……请不要说难听的话……

lines.en: It's nice hearing how excited Sana gets when she’s talking about all of this stuff.
lines.zh: 听着 Sana 聊起这些时那么兴奋，感觉挺好的。

lines.en: It's the first time I've ever really seen her in {i}her element{/i} and, despite the fact that I'd never use my free time on something like this, I'm glad she's found something she enjoys.
lines.zh: 我还是第一次真正看到她{i}如鱼得水{/i}的样子，虽然我自己绝不会把空闲时间花在这种事上，但我很高兴她找到了喜欢的东西。

lines.en: I don't want to say it makes me {i}happy{/i} or anything like that, but it does make me feel like the two of us are getting a little closer.
lines.zh: 我不想说这让我{i}开心{/i}之类的，但它确实让我觉得我们两个的距离近了一点。

lines.en: It's just odd knowing that the deciding factor in making me think that is her showing me her bug collection in a virtual museum.
lines.zh: 只是有点奇怪，让我产生这种想法的关键，竟然是她在一座虚拟博物馆里给我看她收集的虫子。

lines.en: : So, is there like, an objective to this game?
lines.zh: : 那么，这游戏有什么目标之类的吗？

lines.en: scene games5
: Mmm...not really. But also...kind of?...
lines.zh: : 嗯……算是没有吧。但……又好像有？……

lines.en: : Since other people can visit your island...there’s always a lot of pressure to have it look as nice as possible...
lines.zh: : 因为别人可以来你的岛上玩……所以总会有种压力，想把它弄得尽量好看……

lines.en: scene games7
: Oh! Look...There’s someone here now.
lines.zh: : 哦！你看……现在有人来了。

lines.en: : That’s a person you know in real life?
lines.zh: : 那是你在现实里认识的人？

lines.en: : It’s someone...you know in real life as well...
lines.zh: : 是……你在现实里也认识的人……

lines.en: : That...does not look like anyone I know in real life.
lines.zh: : 这……一点也不像我现实里认识的任何一个人。

lines.en: scene games8
: Would you...be surprised if I told you it was Ami?...
lines.zh: : 如果我告诉你那是 Ami……你会不会很惊讶？……

lines.en: : Ami plays this game too? I had no idea.
lines.zh: : Ami 也玩这游戏？我完全不知道。

lines.en: : She probably...plays in her room when you’re not looking...
lines.zh: : 她大概是……趁你不注意的时候在自己房间里玩……

lines.en: : You two...spend a lot of time together...don't you?
lines.zh: : 你们两个……经常待在一起吧……？

lines.en: : More than anyone else, I guess. But she also sleeps in the same building as me, so it's a bit of an unfair advantage.
lines.zh: : 应该比任何人都多吧。不过她也跟我睡在同一栋楼里，所以这算是有点不公平的优势。

lines.en: : That's interesting, though. I didn’t realize you two were close enough to be playing games together.
lines.zh: : 不过这挺有意思的。我没意识到你们两个已经要好到能一起打游戏了。

lines.en: scene games5
: You see...that’s...what I like about games...
lines.zh: : 你看……这就是……我喜欢游戏的地方……

lines.en: : You don’t really need to be close with someone to play with them...
lines.zh: : 你其实不需要跟谁关系很好，也能一起玩……

lines.en: : Take Ami for example...
lines.zh: : 就拿 Ami 来说吧……

lines.en: : She’s not here because she likes me...
lines.zh: : 她来这里不是因为她喜欢我……

lines.en: : She’s here because she needs oranges.
lines.zh: : 她来是因为她需要橘子。

lines.en: : I’m sure that’s not-
lines.zh: : 我相信她不是——

lines.en: : Oh. She's shaking an orange tree.
lines.zh: : 哦。她在摇橘子树。

lines.en: : Heheh...see? I told you...
lines.zh: : 嘿嘿……看吧？我说了……

lines.en: : That doesn't mean she doesn't like you, though, Sana. It-
lines.zh: : 可这也不代表她不喜欢你啊，Sana。她——

lines.en: : Sensei...it's okay. Liking each other doesn't really matter in places like this...
lines.zh: : Sensei……没关系的。在这样的地方，喜不喜欢彼此其实并不重要……

lines.en: : And I'm not even upset that she's taking my resources...because I can always go to her island and take hers as well...
lines.zh: : 她拿走我的资源我也不会生气……因为我随时可以去她的岛上拿她的……

lines.en: : So it’s like an entire world where people just...take stuff from each other?
lines.zh: : 所以这就像是一整个大家互相……拿对方东西的世界？

lines.en: scene games6
: It’s a world where everyone shares...and helps each other out...
lines.zh: : 这是一个大家互相分享……互相帮忙的世界……

lines.en: scene games5
: It’s much better than this world...and that’s why I spend so much time here...
lines.zh: : 它比这个世界好太多了……所以我才在这里待这么久……

lines.en: : I actually...
lines.zh: : 我其实……

lines.en: : I actually get to feel included.
lines.zh: : 我其实也能感觉到自己是其中的一份子。

lines.en: It’s kind of confusing hearing her say something so lonely in such an uplifting way.
lines.zh: 听她用这么轻快的语气说出如此孤独的话，让人有些摸不着头脑。

lines.en: But, as I learn more about Sana, I’m starting to realize that’s just the sort of person she is.
lines.zh: 但随着我对 Sana 了解得更多，我渐渐明白她就是这种人。

lines.en: A person who would rather shrug off the things that make her sad than directly confront and overcome them.
lines.zh: 一个宁愿把让自己难过的事一笑了之，也不愿正面去面对并克服它的人。

lines.en: It’s a great quality to have, don't get me wrong-
lines.zh: 别误会，这其实是个很好的特质——

lines.en: But it can also dramatically backfire.
lines.zh: 但它也可能带来严重的反效果。

lines.en: I'm sure that's just me thinking too much about too little, though.
lines.zh: 不过我想，这大概只是我对一件小事想太多了。

lines.en: : Oh, right! You still haven't picked my outfit.
lines.zh: : 哦，对了！你还没帮我挑衣服呢。

lines.en: : Now...let's see what there is to choose from...
lines.zh: : 那么……看看都有什么可选的……

lines.en: scene black
Sana goes on to play her game for another hour or two, showing me essentially everything there is to know about it.
lines.zh: Sana 接着又玩了一两个小时，基本上把这游戏该知道的都给我讲了一遍。

lines.en: And while I have no intention of actually purchasing it, I fully believe that I could now survive in the world where everyone shares.
lines.zh: 虽然我完全没打算真的去买，但我现在完全相信，自己能在那个所有人互相分享的世界里活下去。

lines.en: The world where everything that's taken can be immediately replaced.
lines.zh: 那个所有被拿走的东西都能立刻补回来的世界。

lines.en: Where everyone gets along and everyone feels included.
lines.zh: 那里每个人都和睦相处，每个人都觉得自己是被接纳的。

lines.en: The exact opposite of the place we fall asleep at night.
lines.zh: 和我们每晚睡去的那个地方截然相反。

lines.zh: {i}Sana 的好感度提升到了 [sana_love]！{/i}
